integrity: A standalone verifier reproduces finite block identities from exact arithmetic. The proof is self-contained conditional only on explicitly cited established number-theoretic theorems.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns squarefree moduli and reduced classes only; it gives no irrationality measure or transcendence statement. Correctness uses standard Dirichlet and prime-number theorems plus the cited primorial translation theorem; finite tests are illustrative, not independent proof. Unindexed equivalent literature remains possible.
title: Irrational record densities in every reduced squarefree progression
